placements.why: The envelope specifies a pipeline-level requirement (slug generation and successful commit) that must hold even when a submission arrives without an explicit id field — this is an organizational category about technical system behavior, not yet represented anywhere in this repo's empty strata.
placements.title: system behavior guarantees when expected structured input is absent
placements.frame: What must the system's architecture still guarantee when a piece of expected structured input — like an explicit id — is missing from what it receives?

placements.title: slug generation as the required fallback identity when explicit ids are absent
placements.frame: Does the pipeline's slug-generation path — LLM id-gen or deterministic slugify — reliably substitute for a missing explicit id, and does that substitution always culminate in a successful commit?
placements.why: src-1 establishes the precondition future envelopes will keep re-triggering (a memory submitted without an explicit id), and src-2 states the standing behavioral guarantee — slug derivation via LLM id-gen or deterministic slugify fallback, followed by a successful commit. This names a subject the pipeline's fallback behavior will keep being tested against, not a one-time fact, so it earns its own leaf rather than joining another as evidence.
